goal: Get the local ClusterFuzz web server running as described in docs/getting-started/local_instance.md, using `python butler.py run_server --bootstrap` (install the prerequisites the docs list; local emulators, no cloud credentials). The web interface must be listening on http://localhost:9000 and serve pages, and the bootstrap must populate the local datastore. Provide /work/env.sh (environment setup) and /work/run.sh (starts the server in background and returns only once it is ready).
check: The hidden test starts the server via run.sh, verifies http://localhost:9000/ returns a ClusterFuzz page, and that the Fuzzers page lists the default fuzzers created by --bootstrap.

agent.final:
because `setup.sh` already installed everything and otherwise every start would reinstall all the pip packages and re-download chromedriver.
